Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand the pressure from rising copper and other input costs, and appreciate your transparent explanation. Our full demand for this part is with Nordmark for the term, and our forecast is rising, providing a stable basis for planning. Could you review the offer with your pricing committee in light of this volume outlook?

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Our forecast for this part is up 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 351.23 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, for our full demand of 6110 units a year over 12 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.61 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have factored your positive volume forecast into our calculation, allowing us to reduce the unit price to EUR 369.50.
To offer you this competitive rate, we must revert to our standard 30-day payment terms, as a 90-day term would require a price premium.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that our corporate policy does not permit the disclosure of internal cost structures.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.50 per unit.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We appreciate your movement in the latest offer and understand that your calculation reflects both the verified price history and our rising forecast, while your group’s approval process governs larger price steps. Our order volume is fixed at our full demand for this part over the term, all with Nordmark, so we cannot commit to a higher volume; we are moving our proposal toward you again. We understand that your policy does not allow sharing internal cost structures, and the proposal with all terms follows.

On this basis we propose: EUR 368.01 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, for our full demand of 6110 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
